<style>
@import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Cinzel:wght@400;600;700;900&family=Cormorant+Garamond:ital,wght@0,300;0,400;0,600;0,700;1,400&family=EB+Garamond:ital,wght@0,400;0,600;1,400&display=swap');

:root {
  /* Cafés oscuros */
  --ink:         #1F1206;
  --dark-brown:  #2E1A0F;
  --chocolate:   #3E2416;
  --coffee:      #5C3A21;
  --walnut:      #6D4C2F;
  --sienna:      #8B5E34;

  /* Cálidos tierra */
  --terracotta:  #A85834;
  --rust:        #B4653A;
  --amber:       #C9821B;

  /* Dorados */
  --bronze:      #8C6A1F;
  --ochre:       #B8892E;
  --gold:        #D4A017;
  --gold-light:  #E8C766;
  --gold-pale:   #F0DFA8;

  /* Neutros cálidos */
  --parchment:   #F5E6C8;
  --cream:       #FBF3DD;
  --marble:      #FAF0DC;
  --beige:       #E7D3A8;

  --ink-text:    #2B1810;
}

/* ===== FONDO EXTERIOR (fuera del papel) ===== */
html {
  background: var(--dark-brown) !important;
  min-height: 100%;
}

/* ===== CUERPO: papel + meandro vertical a los lados ===== */
body {
  font-family: 'EB Garamond', Georgia, serif !important;
  line-height: 1.78 !important;
  color: var(--ink-text) !important;
  font-size: 16.5px !important;
  max-width: 1120px !important;
  margin: 0 auto !important;
  padding: 0 90px !important;
  background-color: var(--parchment) !important;
  /* MEANDRO GRIEGO VERTICAL (izq y der) + relleno dorado */
  background-image:
    url("data:image/svg+xml;utf8,<svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' width='26' height='52' viewBox='0 0 26 52'><path d='M22,2 L22,50 L4,50 L4,10 L18,10 L18,40 L8,40 L8,20 L14,20 L14,32 L11,32 L11,24' stroke='%232E1A0F' stroke-width='2.4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='square' stroke-linejoin='miter'/></svg>"),
    url("data:image/svg+xml;utf8,<svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' width='26' height='52' viewBox='0 0 26 52'><path d='M22,2 L22,50 L4,50 L4,10 L18,10 L18,40 L8,40 L8,20 L14,20 L14,32 L11,32 L11,24' stroke='%232E1A0F' stroke-width='2.4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='square' stroke-linejoin='miter'/></svg>"),
    linear-gradient(90deg, var(--gold) 0%, var(--gold) 100%),
    linear-gradient(90deg, var(--gold) 0%, var(--gold) 100%),
    linear-gradient(180deg, var(--parchment) 0%, var(--cream) 100%) !important;
  background-position:
    left 28px top 0,
    right 28px top 0,
    left 18px top 0,
    right 18px top 0,
    left top !important;
  background-repeat:
    repeat-y,
    repeat-y,
    repeat-y,
    repeat-y,
    no-repeat !important;
  background-size:
    26px 52px,
    26px 52px,
    3px 100%,
    3px 100%,
    100% 100% !important;
  box-shadow:
    0 0 80px rgba(0,0,0,0.55),
    inset 0 0 60px rgba(140,106,31,0.10) !important;
  min-height: 100vh !important;
}

/* ===== CONTENEDOR INTERNO ===== */
.main-container, .container-fluid {
  padding: 0 20px 3rem 20px !important;
  max-width: 100% !important;
}

/* ===== HEADER ===== */
#header {
  margin: 0 -20px 3rem -20px !important;
  padding: 3.5rem 2rem 3rem 2rem !important;
  background:
    linear-gradient(135deg, #2E1A0F 0%, #5C3A21 35%, #8B5E34 55%, #8C6A1F 100%) !important;
  color: var(--parchment) !important;
  text-align: center !important;
  border-top: 5px solid var(--gold) !important;
  border-bottom: 5px solid var(--gold) !important;
  box-shadow:
    inset 0 0 60px rgba(0,0,0,0.45),
    0 8px 30px rgba(0,0,0,0.35) !important;
  position: relative !important;
}

/* Cenefa griega horizontal dentro del header (arriba y abajo) */
#header::before,
#header::after {
  content: "" !important;
  position: absolute !important;
  left: 0 !important;
  right: 0 !important;
  height: 22px !important;
  background-image:
    url("data:image/svg+xml;utf8,<svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' width='44' height='22' viewBox='0 0 44 22'><path d='M2,20 L2,4 L20,4 L20,18 L6,18 L6,8 L16,8 L16,14 L10,14 L10,11' stroke='%23D4A017' stroke-width='1.8' fill='none' stroke-linecap='square'/></svg>") !important;
  background-repeat: repeat-x !important;
  background-size: 44px 22px !important;
  opacity: 0.85 !important;
}
#header::before { top: 6px !important; }
#header::after  { bottom: 6px !important; }

#header .title {
  font-family: 'Cinzel', Georgia, serif !important;
  color: var(--gold-pale) !important;
  font-size: 2.25rem !important;
  font-weight: 900 !important;
  letter-spacing: 3px !important;
  text-transform: uppercase !important;
  margin: 1rem 0 1.2rem 0 !important;
  padding: 0 !important;
  border: none !important;
  text-shadow:
    0 1px 0 #000,
    2px 2px 12px rgba(0,0,0,0.6) !important;
  line-height: 1.28 !important;
}
#header .subtitle {
  font-family: 'Cormorant Garamond', Georgia, serif !important;
  font-style: italic !important;
  color: var(--gold-pale) !important;
  font-size: 1.15rem !important;
  font-weight: 400 !important;
  border: none !important;
  background: none !important;
  padding: 0 !important;
  margin: 0.5rem 0 !important;
  opacity: 0.95;
}
#header .author, #header .date {
  font-family: 'Cormorant Garamond', Georgia, serif !important;
  color: var(--gold-light) !important;
  font-size: 1rem !important;
  font-weight: 400 !important;
  letter-spacing: 2px !important;
  margin: 0.2rem 0 !important;
}

/* ===== ENCABEZADOS ===== */
h1, h2, h3, h4, h5, h6 {

}

  font-size: 2.3rem !important;

  text-transform: uppercase !important;

  padding-bottom: 1rem !important;
  border-bottom: 4px double var(--gold) !important;

}
h1::before { content: "❖ " !important; color: var(--ochre) !important; }
h1::after  { content: " ❖" !important; color: var(--ochre) !important; }

h2 {
  font-size: 1.75rem !important;

}

h6 { font-size: 1rem !important; color: var(--bronze) !important; font-style: italic !important; }

#header h1, #header h2, #header h3, #header h4 { color: var(--gold-pale) !important; }
#header h1::before, #header h1::after { content: "" !important; }

/* ===== TEXTO ===== */
p { text-align: justify !important; hyphens: auto; margin-bottom: 1.1rem !important; }

/* ===== TOC ===== */
#TOC {
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--cream), var(--parchment)) !important;
  border: 2px solid var(--dark-brown) !important;
  border-top: 6px double var(--gold) !important;
  border-bottom: 6px double var(--gold) !important;
  padding: 1.8rem 2rem !important;
  margin: 2rem 0 !important;

  font-family: 'Cormorant Garamond', Georgia, serif !important;
}
#TOC::before {
  content: "❖ Índice de Contenidos ❖";
  display: block;
  font-family: 'Cinzel', Georgia, serif;
  font-size: 1.15rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--chocolate);
  margin-bottom: 1rem;
  padding-bottom: 0.6rem;
  border-bottom: 2px solid var(--gold);
  text-align: center;
  letter-spacing: 2px;
}
#TOC ul { list-style: none !important; padding-left: 0 !important; }
#TOC li { margin: 0.5rem 0 !important; }
#TOC a {
  color: var(--dark-brown) !important;
  text-decoration: none !important;
  font-family: 'EB Garamond', Georgia, serif !important;

}
#TOC a:hover {

}

#TOC ul ul a { font-size: 0.94rem !important; color: var(--walnut) !important; font-style: italic !important; }

/* ===== CÓDIGO ===== */
pre, code { font-family: 'Consolas', 'Monaco', 'Courier New', monospace !important; }

table {

/* ===== BLOCKQUOTE ===== */
blockquote {

.figure img {

p.caption, .caption {

}

/* ===== RESPONSIVE ===== */
@media (max-width: 900px) {
